name: memory
description: 统一记忆工具（action 分派）。action=save 保存一条长期记忆到记忆宫殿（hall：decision/event/discovery/preference/suggestion；preference/suggestion 自动存入全局 user 翼，其余存入当前项目翼）；action=search 深度检索记忆宫殿（L3 全量跨翼 BM25，可按 wing/room/hall 过滤）；action=list_rooms 列出记忆宫殿结构（翼→房间→厅 与数量）。
description_en: Unified memory tool (dispatched by action). action=save stores a long-term memory into the memory palace (hall: decision/event/discovery/preference/suggestion; preference/suggestion go to the global 'user' wing, others to the current project wing); action=search deep-searches the palace (L3 full cross-wing BM25, filterable by wing/room/hall); action=list_rooms lists the palace structure (wing→room→hall with counts).

room.description: save：主题房间名（英文小写连字符，如 context-engine；同类主题保持同名以形成关联）
room.description_en: save: topic room name (lowercase hyphenated, e.g. context-engine; reuse the same name for related topics)

hall.description: 记忆分类（save 必填；search 可选过滤）
hall.description_en: Memory category (required for save; optional filter for search)

verbatim.description: save：对话原文片段（保留关键原话，供追溯）
verbatim.description_en: save: original text fragment from the conversation (keeps key quotes for traceability)

insight.description: save：一句话洞察（将来注入上下文的内容，要自包含、无歧义）
insight.description_en: save: one-sentence insight (injected into future contexts; self-contained and unambiguous)

importance.description: save：重要性 0-1（>=0.75 进入关键事实常驻层；默认 0.5）
importance.description_en: save: importance 0-1 (>=0.75 enters the always-on key facts layer; default 0.5)

query.description: search：检索查询（自然语言关键词）

wing.description: search：限定翼（项目名或 'user'；缺省=全翼检索）
wing.description_en: search: restrict to a wing (project name or 'user'; default = all wings)

topK.description: search：返回条数上限（默认 10，最大 50）
